purpose: Compare the Confirm33 separate-process CUDA-IPC S2 endpoint with conventional-only and local eager-dual baselines on the exact same deterministic channel trace.

source_evidence.note: The source run preceded this comparison protocol. Its exact controller command, including payload seed and output path, was captured while the process was running.

conditions.eager_dual: local NeuralRx and conventional full paths on every release, select NeuralRx when valid
conditions.external_s2: Confirm33 cap80 MPS/CUDA-IPC NeuralRx; conventional executes only on natural NeuralRx failure

interpretation_limit: The inputs are trace-matched but policies run sequentially, so decoder nondeterminism and temporal system drift remain. This compares radio utility and executed work, not background throughput under concurrent third-party AI.
